persons.name: Bailey
persons.harm: A date confined and threatened her, took her phone and cards, and chased her when she escaped. Calls from a detention facility later frightened her while she was listed as a witness.

contacts.what_institution_did: A deputy took notes but did not look for the man; a later detective could not find a filed report.
contacts.quote: He did take notes while I told him what happened, but he didn't make any effort to go find [perpetrator].
contacts.what_happened_next: She paid for a taxi home.
contacts.notes: The missing report is confirmed in her account at 19:45; its cause is unknown.

contacts.when: months later, after a public appeal for information
contacts.what_institution_did: The lead detective searched for her earlier report, took a new statement and checked whether she appeared in assault videos.
contacts.quote: So the detective asked me some other questions and I was able to tell him what [perpetrator]'s apartment looked like and it's hard, et cetera.
contacts.what_happened_next: She was added to the witness list.

contacts.when: after calls from the detention facility
contacts.what_institution_did: The detective said she could answer because calls were recorded.
contacts.quote: I was terrified to answer, but when I told the detective about it, his advice was that it was okay to answer because the line is recorded, but the last person I wanted to talk to was [perpetrator], or someone that he would have called me to intimidate me.
contacts.notes: Advice did not resolve her fear; she never answered.

contacts.when: while the criminal case was pending
contacts.what_institution_did: She was subpoenaed, then repeatedly notified of postponements; she ultimately was not needed to testify.
contacts.quote: I'm not exactly sure on time, but it was it was a lot of I'd get letters like this has been postponed or there's a continuance, et cetera.
contacts.notes: The number and dates of postponements are unspecified; they are not invented as separate numbered events.

contacts.what_institution_did: The perpetrator was found guilty and sentenced to life.
contacts.quote: So was found guilty and sentenced to life in prison.

contacts.when: about eight months before the interview
contacts.what_institution_did: Therapy helped her understand experiences and feel more peaceful.
contacts.quote: And the amount of healing that has happened just within those months has been incredible.

persons.outcome_quote: And I actually sleep better at night because of that. I don't have nightmares anymore.
persons.decisive_work_quote: And for many of those witnesses, there was video evidence. So my testimony wasn't needed.
persons.notes: She escaped before the first police response, but later intimidating detention-facility calls and fear continued. Life imprisonment is explicitly linked to her subsequent safety and end of nightmares. Other victims and video evidence are described; this is not a claim that their records were independently checked by the show.

persons.notes: No institutional report about the deception is described. The school support concerned the murder, not this deceptive friendship. She blocked the woman on all platforms.

contacts.what_institution_did: The school helped with the memorial, rescheduled midterms and offered medical withdrawal.
contacts.quote: Our professors were very aware of how impacted we were by this event. And so because of that, they really wanted to work with us to reschedule our midterms to make sure we were in this event.

persons.decisive_work_quote: The dean of the school even told us that we could have a medical withdrawal from the semester if we needed to.
persons.notes: This record codes institutional accommodation of ongoing bereavement, not protection from the killing itself. Group support is described collectively; no individual withdrawal or particular rescheduled examination is inferred.

persons.name: Ava (husband)
persons.harm: Her husband lied about his identity, coerced sex, restrained and stalked her, and repeatedly disrupted her work. After separation he used threats, pets and unwanted contact to retain control.

contacts.what_institution_did: The employer dismissed her for personal issues arising from her husband’s repeated appearances.
contacts.quote: And he actually got me let go from my job because he kept showing up there.
contacts.notes: The following line says they were going to let her go; employment loss is explicitly linked to the stalking.

contacts.what_was_asked: Help telling her husband the relationship was over
contacts.what_institution_did: The therapist met her individually, agreed the situation was toxic and saw the husband separately.
contacts.quote: And so I found a therapist who I met with on my own first and explain the situation and I told him that it's Completely over. There's no reconciliation with this and he agreed that it seemed pretty toxic.

contacts.what_was_asked: Support communicating that she wanted divorce
contacts.what_institution_did: The therapist tried to calm him and tell him to listen.
contacts.quote: And he just flew off the handle again and the therapist tried saying, [perpetrator], you need to calm down and [perpetrator], this is what she's telling you, you need to listen.

contacts.what_institution_did: The therapist escorted her and interfered when the husband waited outside.
contacts.quote: Well, he was definitely out there waiting for me, and the therapist had to interfere and prevent him from trying to get to me.

contacts.when: after suicidal threats involving a gun
contacts.what_was_asked: Respond to threatened suicide used in the continuing harassment
contacts.what_institution_did: Police attended after her partner called.
contacts.quote: the police showed up.
contacts.notes: Her later partner called after the threat. No police response to the coercive-control aspect or removal of a gun is reported.

persons.outcome_quote: The contact with him didn't really die down until maybe last year.
persons.notes: The therapist provided real immediate safety at one session, but the harassment continued for years and diminished through personal distancing and his new relationship rather than sustained institutional protection. Her employer penalized her. Divorce and later marriage are described without a court response to the abuse; routine marital status changes are not coded as abuse contacts.

persons.name: Ava (cabin violence)

quotes.quote: And I tried to call the police, but they didn't answer.

persons.outcome_quote: And I tried to call the police, but they didn't answer.
persons.notes: She tried to summon police during the violent crisis, but the call went unanswered. This is failed access, not evidence that an officer learned of the harm. No completed institutional contact is coded. The incident ended after the woman fell asleep; the narrator spent the night managing the danger.

persons.name: Emma (husband)
persons.harm: Her husband repeatedly had sex despite her refusals, undermined her mental health, relied on her financially, and publicly humiliated her. Learning of his assaults of other women prompted a final divorce and move.

contacts.when: after learning about an employee’s assault
contacts.what_was_asked: Advice about confronting her husband and obtaining divorce
contacts.what_institution_did: The lawyer cautioned against confronting him without proof while trying to secure divorce.
contacts.quote: And I had called my lawyer about it Should I confront him with this issue and the lawyer knowing that I wanted to file and wanted to get this thing done It's just possible and he had cautioned know at that time because there was no proof.
contacts.notes: Quoted transcription is garbled but the advisory response is explicit. This is legal assistance, not a court ruling about the allegations.

contacts.when: after moving to a new city
contacts.what_institution_did: Weekly therapy including EMDR helped her process her marriage and guilt.
contacts.quote: And since then, just going through therapy weekly and it's been amazing and eye opening and it started to help me out a lot with the guilt that I was facing with these women and trying to go through each individual memory that we had throughout our marriage and our relationship EMDR has been incredibly helpful for anyone in PTSD.

persons.outcome_quote: I sold my house, I got divorced and I moved to a brand new city.
persons.notes: Her own decision, separation and relocation ended the marriage; no criminal sanction or institutional removal of the perpetrator’s access to her is described. A divorce was finalized, but the transcript does not establish that her own abuse was brought before the court, so the routine dissolution is not coded as an abuse-response contact or institutional protection. Therapy later helped recovery. Legal advice concerned confronting the husband about the other women’s allegations while securing signatures.

persons.name: Angie
persons.harm: Her husband used financial dependence, threats and punishment to coerce unwanted sex with others and recording of it. After separation he stalked and intimidated her; police initially discounted the danger, and a crisis hold later restricted her intended career.

quotes.quote: I had no money. I had no job, I had nothing. He supported me, I lived in his house, I drove his car, I had his credit card.
And I kind of backed off from the charges because I saw what his charges were for the sex trafficking ring. He got probation and no jail time.
It took me like a week to tell my commander what had happened because I was so afraid of what was going to happen.

contacts.institution: detective and command staff at her police department
contacts.when: after repeated unexplained entries into her apartment
contacts.what_institution_did: She reported fear, weapons and possible bond violations; staff said it would go up the chain.
contacts.quote: They were like, okay, we're gonna have to send this up, the chain of command, because this
contacts.notes: Sentence continues at 27:13 as a big deal; no weapons action at this stage is stated.

contacts.what_institution_did: The commander arranged a lock change.
contacts.quote: So I talked to my commander about it and he's like, we'll get your locks changed. So we got my locks changed.
contacts.what_happened_next: The door was open again a week later.

contacts.what_institution_did: He rejected her account because the lock had already been changed.
contacts.quote: He was like, it can't be him, we changed your locks. He can't get in. It's not him, you're forgetting to close it.

contacts.what_institution_did: A second change provided a brand-new lock with only her holding a key.
contacts.quote: and we'll make sure that it's a brand new lock. You'll be the only one who has the key to it.
contacts.what_happened_next: No further open-door incidents were reported; her fear and threats continued.

contacts.institution: crisis response team and mental health facility
contacts.when: during suicidality and severe weight loss
contacts.what_institution_did: She was placed on a 72-hour mental health hold despite pleading that it would damage her career.
contacts.quote: And they ended up putting me on a mental health hold, a 72 hour hold, which is a hard thing for me.
contacts.notes: She recognizes she was in serious trouble but questions this intervention. The later five-year officer-eligibility exclusion is coded separately.

contacts.what_was_asked: Treatment of trauma, eating disorder and depression
contacts.what_institution_did: Therapy and neurofeedback helped reduce her fear response.
contacts.quote: I started doing that treatment, and that really helped, and doing the therapy helped, and started doing yoga, and just trying to calm my brain down.

contacts.what_was_asked: Audit and explanation of the joint tax situation
contacts.what_institution_did: The IRS questioned her and recognized that her husband had falsified deductions.
contacts.quote: So I went and I talked to the IRS and they asked me a lot of questions and it became pretty apparent to me and to the IRS that he had lied on a lot of his deductions.
contacts.notes: No audit disposition or relief of her liability is stated.

contacts.when: a week after a stranger threatened her on a trail
contacts.what_was_asked: Protection from threats and her armed husband
contacts.what_institution_did: The commander minimized the threat; officers checked her apartment for reassurance.
contacts.quote: He's trying to intimidate you, but he won't ever hurt anybody. That's just not who he is. He's a wimpy IT guy. You don't need to be afraid.
contacts.notes: Concrete apartment checks were also made; the quoted passage directly shows dismissal of the danger.

contacts.what_institution_did: He said they would get her husband for something else because her allegations would be hard to prove.
contacts.quote: And I was told, Angie, we will get him. We won't get him for what he did to you, but we will get him.
contacts.what_happened_next: She backed away from pursuing abuse charges.

contacts.what_institution_did: Officers overcame violent resistance, arrested him and obtained his guns.
contacts.quote: And they finally got him down and they were able to take him into custody. And when they did that, they were able to get his guns.
contacts.notes: Public body-camera evidence is described; the record_checked_by_show code is not used in the person’s overall evidence list because independent show review is not expressly stated.

contacts.what_institution_did: The judge ordered GPS monitoring following release on bail.
contacts.quote: The judge ordered that he be tracked by a GPS ankle monitor and returned a court for trial.
contacts.what_happened_next: He cut off the monitor and fled.

contacts.when: when the monitor tampering alert went out
contacts.what_institution_did: An officer took her to the department while police searched.
contacts.quote: One of the other officers came and got me and I was taken to the police department and I felt safe-ish, but I was just, I knew it wasn't gonna be good.

contacts.institution: officers locating him out of state
contacts.what_institution_did: Officers located him with a larger response recognizing his violence risk; he died by suicide during the episode.
contacts.quote: About a week later, detectives were able to locate [perpetrator] out of state.
contacts.notes: No capture or prevention of suicide is claimed.

contacts.what_institution_did: Ketamine treatment reduced her suicidality.
contacts.quote: I still struggle with the depression and at some level, the eating disorder, but the ketamine really took away the suicidality.

contacts.when: when she sought to become a sworn officer
contacts.what_institution_did: Her suicidality and 72-hour hold made her ineligible for five years.
contacts.quote: I wanted to be a cop because of my Suicideality in the 72 hour hold I was told that I'm Uneligible to be a cop for five years and I'm in my 40s.
contacts.notes: This is an employment consequence of the hold; it is not a finding about the appropriate clinical response.

persons.outcome_quote: It's been an interesting period for me where I guess I'm not living in fear anymore. And I'm not afraid anymore.
persons.notes: The final end to fear followed his death rather than effective sustained institutional protection. Locks, checks, weapons seizure, custody and monitoring offered real intermediate safety but did not end the threat. Career harm remained. The supposedly sympathetic counselor described only by the husband is not treated as a verified institutional response: she expressly doubts that he attended. His financial-crime investigation is included where it materially changed her safety, not as a separate victimless contact. Initial notification of the husband’s arrest for crimes against children and a call asking for arrest information are contextual events; the account does not establish that her own abuse was disclosed at those meetings, so they are not abuse-response contacts for her.

persons.name: Beth (hit-and-run)
persons.harm: A drunk driver struck her, carried her on the windshield and drove away after she fell off. She suffered near-fatal injuries but survived emergency treatment and hospital care.

contacts.what_institution_did: Emergency responders transported her to hospital; despite grave expectations, she survived.
contacts.quote: Beth was then taken to a hospital and of course the family members all went there as well.
